raw_observations.observation: The bounded_decision object can express a bounded claim decision or a system-conformance decision, but does not explicitly separate the two.
raw_observations.effect: The Brain2Qwerty scientific claim is supportable while CL-3 conformance remains blocked.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add decision_object_type and separate claim_adjudication from conformance_decision.

raw_observations.observation: AP-4 combines consumer, commercial, mental-state inference, and generative decoding states.
raw_observations.effect: A research-only generative decoder triggers AP-4 even without consumer or commercial deployment.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Introduce AP-4 subprofiles or explicit deployment-state modifiers.

raw_observations.observation: Finding statuses do not distinguish unavailable public evidence from evaluated nonconformance.
raw_observations.effect: NOT ASSESSED carries both access gaps and genuinely unexecuted evaluations.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add INSUFFICIENT PUBLIC EVIDENCE and PRIVATE RECORD REQUIRED states.

raw_observations.observation: The endpoint object lacks explicit fields for metric direction, aggregation unit, derivation, and best-case versus mean status.
raw_observations.effect: The 78% word-accuracy statement is derived from best-participant WER 0.22 and requires manual boundary text.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add metric_direction, aggregation_level, statistic_type, derivation, and denominator fields.

raw_observations.observation: The evidence model does not directly encode paper-to-code-to-checkpoint configuration relationships.
raw_observations.effect: The released TinyLlama/rank-2 default and paper-best Qwen3-4B/rank-128 state require narrative reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add configuration_relationship objects with SAME, SUBSET, ALTERNATE, SUPERSEDED, and UNRESOLVED relations.

raw_observations.observation: Signal-versus-prior decomposition is a requirement but lacks a structured contribution matrix.
raw_observations.effect: Neural, motor, CTC, sentence-corpus, participant, and LLM contributions must be expressed in free text.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add a contribution-control matrix with ablation target, comparator, metric delta, uncertainty, and residual confounds.

raw_observations.observation: “Real-time” has no controlled latency taxonomy.
raw_observations.effect: Asynchronous whole-sentence operation is easily confused with causal low-latency streaming.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add causal, incremental, asynchronous, batch, end-to-end latency, and output-availability fields.

raw_observations.observation: The claim register does not explicitly label corporate, paper, project-page, media, and inferred-public claims as distinct claimant states.
raw_observations.effect: Claim reconciliation requires careful use of claimant and evidence-state prose.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add claimant_record_type and verbatim/source-location fields.

raw_observations.observation: Research-scope inapplicability and prohibited future-use safeguards can appear logically inconsistent.
raw_observations.effect: Sectoral rows are inapplicable to the exact study but remain essential reopening gates.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Separate current applicability from future-use gate status.

raw_observations.observation: The instrument has no dedicated source-version reconciliation object.
raw_observations.effect: V1 arXiv and final Nature numerical differences require manual version controls.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add source_version_relationship and authoritative-result-state fields.

raw_observations.observation: Regulatory-decision object
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Separate legal authorization, evidence of effectiveness and universal conformance as different decisions with different authorities.

raw_observations.observation: Authorization baseline versus deployed build
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add explicit version relationships among supplement, labeling, firmware, software build, site configuration and later maintenance supplement.

raw_observations.observation: Trial-identity integrity
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Make registry-pointer discrepancies first-class provenance objects with adjudication and propagation controls.

raw_observations.observation: Endpoint versioning
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Represent protocol-defined, amended, post-hoc, sensitivity and publication endpoints as linked but distinct objects.

raw_observations.observation: Denominator transitions
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Track enrollment, setup, excluded mode, full-analysis-set, completer, preference, long-term and postmarket denominators without implicit substitution.

raw_observations.observation: Fallback and override semantics
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Distinguish pause-to-safe-therapy, stop-stimulation, clinician override, patient authority and emergency state.

raw_observations.observation: Operational burden
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add structured setup visits, pauses, reprogramming, caregiver dependence, travel and follow-up load as outcome and access variables.

raw_observations.observation: Public absence versus private existence
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Represent evidence known to be regulator-held or manufacturer-held separately from evidence whose existence is unknown.

raw_observations.observation: Postmarket denominator control
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add a model/build/exposure denominator object linked to complaints, MDRs, recalls and annual reports.

raw_observations.observation: Component-specific restriction
raw_observations.effect: Observed during authorization, endpoint and lifecycle reconciliation.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Permit prohibited configurations to attach directly to the exact system boundary and decision.

raw_observations.observation: The instrument needs a formal distinction between researcher-free operation, care-partner-independent operation and infrastructure-independent operation.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add a multi-axis independence object covering setup, daily use, maintenance, recovery, transport and sponsor support.

raw_observations.observation: A longitudinal case can contain many materially different configurations under one participant label.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add configuration epochs and mandatory endpoint-to-epoch links.

raw_observations.observation: Naturalistic participant-rated accuracy and ground-truth copy-task accuracy require separate endpoint classes.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add ground-truth provenance, correction timing and participant-rating semantics.

raw_observations.observation: Effective capability depends on corrections, gaze, care partners and language priors, not only the neural decoder.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add functional contribution decomposition across neural, model, UI and human support layers.

raw_observations.observation: Continuous recalibration turns personal-use data governance into an operational system property.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add model-update lineage linked to consent, privacy mode, retention and withdrawal.

raw_observations.observation: Participant co-design is not equivalent to formal governance authority.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Separate consultation, co-design, voting, veto, evidence-use control and dissent.

raw_observations.observation: Performance stability cannot stand in for implant safety or device-wear evidence.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add an explicit prohibition on substituting capability continuity for safety endpoints.

raw_observations.observation: Essential assistive benefit increases the severity of post-trial continuity obligations.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add dependency-accrual and reliance-transition triggers.

raw_observations.observation: Workplace use can occur inside a research/home case without an institutional deployment.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add incidental sensitive-context exposure and employer data-boundary fields.

raw_observations.observation: Public reproduction assets can reproduce figures without reproducing the system.
raw_observations.effect: Observed during longitudinal participant-specific home-use execution.
raw_observations.candidate_change: Add reproducibility tiers for analysis, endpoint, model, online system and clinical workflow.

consolidated_changes.title: Separate claim adjudication, authorization and conformance decisions
consolidated_changes.required_change: Add typed decision objects with distinct authority, scope, evidence threshold and reopening rules.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: The same case can support a bounded claim or legal authorization while system conformance remains blocked.

consolidated_changes.title: Add deployment-state modifiers and future-use gates
consolidated_changes.required_change: Separate technical function from research, clinical, consumer, workplace and other deployment states; preserve future-use gates.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: A research system is not misclassified as a deployed consumer or institutional system.

consolidated_changes.title: Expand evidence availability and access states
consolidated_changes.required_change: Distinguish insufficient public evidence, private record required, evidence known to exist, evaluation not executed and demonstrated nonconformance.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Missing public evidence is never represented as proof of conformity or failure.

consolidated_changes.title: Strengthen endpoint, denominator, ground-truth and correction semantics
consolidated_changes.required_change: Add metric direction, aggregation, denominator, protocol state, ground-truth source, correction timing and participant-rating fields.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Every quantitative claim is reconstructable and cannot silently change denominator or endpoint class.

consolidated_changes.title: Create configuration, version, source and epoch relationship graph
consolidated_changes.required_change: Add SAME, SUBSET, ALTERNATE, SUPERSEDED and UNRESOLVED relations across paper, code, checkpoint, device, software build, labeling and longitudinal epochs.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Every claim and endpoint resolves to an exact configuration and source version.

consolidated_changes.title: Add functional-contribution and multi-axis independence objects
consolidated_changes.required_change: Represent neural, algorithmic, UI, human-support and infrastructure contributions, plus independence across setup, use, maintenance, recovery and transport.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Capability and independence claims identify every material contributor and dependency.

consolidated_changes.title: Add controlled latency and output-availability taxonomy
consolidated_changes.required_change: Represent causal, incremental, asynchronous, batch and end-to-end latency with measurement points.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Real-time claims use a defined and measured latency class.

consolidated_changes.title: Strengthen claimant and public-claim provenance
consolidated_changes.required_change: Add claimant record type, verbatim wording, source location, publication state and propagation history.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Corporate, paper, project-page, media and inferred claims remain distinct.

consolidated_changes.title: Add trial and regulatory provenance-integrity objects
consolidated_changes.required_change: Represent registry-pointer discrepancies, adjudicated identities, authoritative source and propagation controls.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Incorrect links cannot silently corrupt trial-publication-regulatory graphs.

consolidated_changes.title: Formalize fallback, override, cessation and emergency states
consolidated_changes.required_change: Represent patient, clinician, system and emergency authority with tested state transitions.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Every hazardous or degraded state has an auditable safe transition.

consolidated_changes.title: Make operational burden a structured outcome and access variable
consolidated_changes.required_change: Record setup, calibration, pauses, reprogramming, travel, caregiver and follow-up burdens.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Benefit and access claims include the work required to operate the system.

consolidated_changes.title: Add postmarket exposure denominators and component restrictions
consolidated_changes.required_change: Link vigilance events to model/build/exposure denominators and attach prohibited configurations to exact system boundaries.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Postmarket rates and restrictions remain configuration-specific.

consolidated_changes.title: Link model-update lineage to consent and neural-data governance
consolidated_changes.required_change: Connect each retraining or update event to source data, privacy state, participant authority, retention and withdrawal.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Continuous learning remains traceable and consent-bounded.

consolidated_changes.title: Represent participant authority as distinct governance powers
consolidated_changes.required_change: Separate consultation, co-design, voting, veto, evidence-use control and dissent.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Participation or satisfaction cannot be mistaken for governance authority.

consolidated_changes.title: Prohibit substitution of capability continuity for safety evidence
consolidated_changes.required_change: Add an explicit cross-object rule separating performance, implant integrity, adverse events and trial safety.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Longitudinal function cannot be cited as proof of safety.

consolidated_changes.title: Add dependency-accrual and continuity triggers
consolidated_changes.required_change: Increase continuity obligations when participants rely on an investigational or supplier-dependent function.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Essential reliance triggers funded transition, support and cessation duties.

consolidated_changes.title: Add tiered reproducibility states
consolidated_changes.required_change: Distinguish reproducibility of figures, analysis, endpoints, models, online systems and clinical workflows.
consolidated_changes.acceptance_test: Public analysis code cannot be represented as full-system reproduction.
